december-revolution-transition.ar: إنشاء بعثة يونيتامس بقرار مجلس الأمن 2524، 3 يونيو 2020

war-in-sudan-saf-vs-rsf.en: Jeddah Declaration on protection of civilians, 11 May 2023

daju-kingdom.en: Indigenous dynasty preceding the Fur state, flourishing in the 13th–14th centuries by oral tradition (GHA5_CH7 p.187)
daju-kingdom.ar: أسرة محلية سبقت دولة الفور وازدهرت في القرنين الثالث عشر والرابع عشر بحسب الرواية الشفهية (GHA5_CH7 p.187) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'According to oral tradition the Für state was preceded by two indigenous dynasties: Dädjü and Tundjür'

tunjur-kingdom.en: Succeeds the Daju in Darfur in the early 15th century; later driven out by the Fur (GHA5_CH7 pp.187–188)
tunjur-kingdom.ar: خلفوا الداجو في دارفور مطلع القرن الخامس عشر، ثم طردهم الفور لاحقاً (GHA5_CH7 pp.187–188) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'they were succeeded by the Tundjür at the beginning of the fifteenth century' (p.187); 'drove out the Tundjür' (p.188)

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Fur dynasty from around Jabal Marra; Sulayman Solongdungu probably the founder; the Kayra sultanate flourished c.1640–1874, restored 1898, annexed 1916 (GHA V ch.7 p.187); O'Fahey (2008) dates it c.1650–1916 (page not confirmed) [VERIFY]
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: أسرة فوراوية من منطقة جبل مرة؛ ولعل سليمان سولونج مؤسسها؛ ازدهرت سلطنة الكيرا نحو 1640–1874، وأعيدت 1898، وضُمّت 1916 (GHA V ch.7 p.187)؛ ويؤرخها أوفاهي (2008) بنحو 1650–1916 (الصفحة غير مؤكدة) [VERIFY] [يحتاج تحقق]

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Muhammad Tayrab takes Kordofan from the Musabba'at; it stays with the Fur until the Turco-Egyptian conquest (GHA V ch.7 p.189)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: التوسع في كردفان في عهد محمد تيراب نحو 1785 [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: GHA V ch.7 p.189

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Permanent capital grows at al-Fashir under 'Abd al-Rahman (d. 1801–2) (GHA V ch.7 pp.190–191)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: تثبيت العاصمة في الفاشر نحو 1790/1791 في عهد عبد الرحمن [يحتاج تحقق]
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.date_note: GHA V p.190 prints 1741-2 for 'Abd al-Rahman's new fashir at Khor Tandalti; his reign ended 1801-2, so this is probably a misprint for 1791-2. Not plotted. VERIFY

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Sultan Ibrahim defeated and killed by al-Zubayr at Manawashi, 1874; Darfur annexed to the Turco-Egyptian regime (GHA VI ch.14 p.371)

cite.cite_text: GHA VI ch.14 p.371

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Ahmad Bukr b. Musa (c.1682–1722) pushes north and north-west, annexing Dar Kimr; the Kayra meet the Zaghawa and Wadai (GHA5_CH7 p.188)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: أحمد بكر بن موسى (نحو 1682–1722) يتوسع شمالاً وشمالاً غربياً ويضم دار قِمر، فيحتك الكيرا بالزغاوة ووداي (GHA5_CH7 p.188) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'his successor Ahmad Bukr b. Musa (c. 1682-1722), who pushed on to the north and north-west annexing the strategic state of Dar Kimr.'

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: The eunuch Muhammad Kurra, Ab Shaykh, is from about 1790 to 1804 the strongest man in the Fur state (GHA5_CH7 p.189)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: الخصي محمد كُرّا، أب شيخ، أقوى رجل في دولة الفور من نحو 1790 إلى 1804 (GHA5_CH7 p.189) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'As the chief, Muhammad Kurra was from about 1790 to 1804 the strongest man in the state.'

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: W. G. Browne stays in Darfur 1793–6 and describes the sultan as the chief merchant of the country (GHA5_CH7 p.190)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: و. ج. براون يقيم في دارفور 1793–1796 ويصف السلطان بأنه كبير تجار البلاد (GHA5_CH7 p.190) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Browne, who visited Darfur in 1793-6, describes the role of the king as follows: The king is the chief merchant in the country'

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: Sultan 'Abd al-Rahman corresponds with Bonaparte in 1799 during the French occupation of Egypt (GHA5_CH7 p.190)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: السلطان عبد الرحمن يراسل بونابرت عام 1799 أثناء الاحتلال الفرنسي لمصر (GHA5_CH7 p.190) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'He also corresponded with Bonaparte in 1799 during the French occupation of Egypt.'

sultanate-of-darfur-keira.en: On 'Abd al-Rahman's death in 1801–2 his son Muhammad al-Fadl succeeds with the help of Muhammad Kurra (GHA5_CH7 p.191)
sultanate-of-darfur-keira.ar: عند وفاة عبد الرحمن في 1801–1802 يخلفه ابنه محمد الفضل بمساعدة محمد كُرّا (GHA5_CH7 p.191) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'On the death of 'Abd al-Rahman in 1801-2 his son Muhammad al-Fadl succeeded him with the help of Muhammad Kurra.'

restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.en: Ali Dinar rules, nominally tributary to but effectively independent of the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan (GHA7_CH12 p.283)
restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.ar: علي دينار يحكم، تابعاً اسمياً للسودان الإنجليزي المصري ومستقلاً عنه فعلياً (GHA7_CH12 p.283) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'nominally tributary to, but effectively independent of, the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan'

restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.date_note: GHA VII p.283: 'Not until February 1916 was he defeated and killed in battle'; other accounts put his death later in 1916. Year 1916 kept. VERIFY

restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.en: Sultan 'Ali Dinar answers the Ottoman call to jihad in the First World War, raids French Chad, threatens British Borno and tries to stir revolt in Kordofan (GHA7_CH12 p.283)
restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.ar: السلطان علي دينار يستجيب لدعوة الجهاد العثمانية في الحرب العالمية الأولى، فيغير على تشاد الفرنسية ويهدد برنو البريطانية ويحاول إثارة الثورة في كردفان (GHA7_CH12 p.283) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'responded to the Turkish call to djihad and raided French Chad, threatened British Borno (Northern Nigeria) and tried to stir up revolt in Kordofan (Sudan).'

restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.date_note: Not dated on GHA VII p.283 beyond the First World War (the Ottoman call to jihad was issued after Turkey entered the war in late 1914); plotted at 1915. VERIFY

restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.en: The Darfur sultanate is restored in 1898 (GHA5_CH7 p.187)
restored-darfur-sultanate-ali-dinar.ar: استعادة سلطنة دارفور عام 1898 (GHA5_CH7 p.187) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'It was restored in 1898'

kingdom-of-taqali.removed: r25 triage: no registered source read this round states Taqali incorporation into the Condominium administration

kingdom-of-taqali.en: Nuba Mountains kingdom; tributary to Funj/Darfur at times
kingdom-of-taqali.ar: مملكة في جبال النوبة؛ تابعة بالخراج للفونج أو دارفور في بعض الأحيان [يحتاج تحقق]
kingdom-of-taqali.date_note: GHA V p.177 n.24: the tributary relation to the Funj is disputed

kingdom-of-taqali.en: The freebooter Muhammad al-Khayr moves from Taqali to Kaka on the White Nile in 1854 (GHA6_CH14 p.364)
kingdom-of-taqali.ar: المغامر محمد الخير ينتقل من تقلي إلى كاكا على النيل الأبيض عام 1854 (GHA6_CH14 p.364) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The activities of the freebooter, Muhammad al-Khayr, a Dongalawi by birth, who moved to Kaka from Taqali in 1854'

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.removed: no source page found: S/2005/60 p.19 para 45 gives the start of the second war in 1983 but no end year 2005; HRW not a UN/aid source

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: The Zande ruler Yambio, his military power broken, meets a government expedition in January 1905; defeated and imprisoned, he dies on 10 February 1905 (GHA7_CH4 p.82)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.ar: الحاكم الزاندي يامبيو، بعد انكسار قوته العسكرية، يواجه حملة حكومية في يناير 1905، فيُهزم ويُسجن ويموت في 10 فبراير 1905 (GHA7_CH4 p.82) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'He was ultimately defeated and imprisoned, and died soon afterwards, on 10 February 1905.'

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: The Nuer leader Dowl Diu attacks a government post in 1914 (GHA7_CH4 p.81)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.ar: الزعيم النويري دول ديو يهاجم مركزاً حكومياً عام 1914 (GHA7_CH4 p.81) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in 1914 another Nuer leader, Dowl Diu, attacked a government post.'

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: The Aliab Dinka uprising begins on 30 October 1919, joined by the Mandari (GHA7_CH23 p.594)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.ar: انتفاضة دينكا علياب تبدأ في 30 أكتوبر 1919 وينضم إليها المنداري (GHA7_CH23 p.594) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The Aliab Dinka uprising began on 30 October 1919, when a force of about three thousand warriors attacked the police'

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: Followers of the Dinka prophet Ariendit, mobilised by 1921 against colonial rule, are dispersed in February–March 1922 (GHA7_CH23 p.595)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.ar: أتباع النبي الدينكاوي أرينديت، الذين حشدهم بحلول 1921 ضد الاستعمار، يُشتتون في فبراير–مارس 1922 (GHA7_CH23 p.595) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'His militant supporters made various attacks on colonial positions, but they were dispersed in February-March 1922.'

southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.en: In December 1927 several thousand Nuer warriors attack the party of Fergusson, district commissioner of western Nuerland, at Lake Jorr (GHA7_CH23 p.595)
southern-sudan-under-condominium-sudan.ar: في ديسمبر 1927 يهاجم عدة آلاف من محاربي النوير موكب فيرغسون، مفتش مركز غرب النوير، عند بحيرة جور (GHA7_CH23 p.595) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'When Fergusson, the district commissioner of western Nuerland, arrived in December 1927 at Lake Jorr on an inspection tour, a crowd of several thousand Nuer warriors attacked his party.'

republic-of-south-sudan.en: Independence 9 July 2011; UNMISS created by UNSC res. 1996 (8 Jul 2011)
republic-of-south-sudan.ar: الاستقلال 9 يوليو 2011؛ إنشاء بعثة أونميس بقرار مجلس الأمن 1996 (8 يوليو 2011)

republic-of-south-sudan.en: Civil war from 15 Dec 2013 (UNMISS_HRR2014 PDF p.10, para 1)
republic-of-south-sudan.ar: الحرب الأهلية منذ 15 ديسمبر 2013 (UNMISS_HRR2014 PDF p.10, para 1) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'On 15 December 2013, an internal power struggle within the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement (SPLM), South Sudan’s ruling political party, came to a head'

republic-of-south-sudan.removed: no source page found: S/RES/2459 p.1 names the 2018 Revitalised Agreement but not the 12 Sep 2018 signing date

republic-of-south-sudan.en: Transitional Government of National Unity (TGoNU) formed 22 Feb 2020 under the Revitalized Agreement
republic-of-south-sudan.ar: تشكيل حكومة الوحدة الوطنية الانتقالية في 22 فبراير 2020 بموجب الاتفاق المنشط [يحتاج تحقق]

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.en: From about 3000 BCE the Egyptians, according to their chroniclers, are able to check Libyan invasions (GHA2_CH4 p.139)
early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.ar: منذ نحو 3000 ق.م. يتمكن المصريون، بحسب مدوّنيهم، من صدّ غزوات الليبيين (GHA2_CH4 p.139) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'From - 3000 to - 1800 the Egyptians were able, according to their chroniclers, to check Libyan invasions.'

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.en: King Zoser founds the third dynasty; his architect Imhotep builds the step pyramid at Saqqara, substituting stone for brick (GHA2_CH2 p.91)
early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.ar: الملك زوسر يؤسس الأسرة الثالثة، ويبني مهندسه إمحوتب الهرم المدرّج في سقارة مستبدلاً الحجر بالطوب (GHA2_CH2 p.91) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The dynasty was founded by King Zoser who was evidently a strong and able ruler.'

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.91 dates the Old Kingdom from -2900; Zoser's reign is not separately dated

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.en: From about 2500 BCE the Egyptians set up furnaces at Buhen, south of Wadi Halfa, to smelt local copper (GHA2_CH4 p.142)
early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.ar: منذ نحو 2500 ق.م. يقيم المصريون أفراناً في بوهين جنوب وادي حلفا لصهر النحاس المحلي (GHA2_CH4 p.142) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'As from - 2500 furnaces designed to melt the local copper were set up by the Egyptians at Buhen, south of Wadi Haifa.'

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.en: Expeditions under Cheops, Dedefre and Sahure quarry diorite west of Toshka in Lower Nubia for royal statues (GHA2_CH9 p.250)
early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.ar: بعثات في عهود خوفو وجدف رع وساحورع تقتلع الديوريت غرب توشكى في النوبة السفلى لصنع التماثيل الملكية (GHA2_CH9 p.250) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The diorite deposits west of Toshka were quarried for stone for royal statues, and inscriptions of Cheops, the owner of the great pyramid at Giza, Dedefre, and Sahure of the fifth dynasty (- 2563 to - 2423) were engraved on the rocks there'

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.date_note: Plotted at the start of the fifth dynasty as dated on GHA II p.250; the Cheops and Dedefre inscriptions are earlier (fourth dynasty)

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.en: Under the sixth dynasty Egypt's southern border is at Aswan, where records of King Merenre are found at the First Cataract (GHA2_CH9 p.250)
early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.ar: في عهد الأسرة السادسة تقع حدود مصر الجنوبية عند أسوان، حيث عُثر على نقشين للملك مرنرع عند الشلال الأول (GHA2_CH9 p.250) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Two records of King Merenre discovered at the First Cataract24 may be taken as an indication that Egypt's southern border was at Aswan during the sixth dynasty (- 2434 to - 2242)'

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.date_note: Plotted at the start of the sixth dynasty as dated on GHA II p.250

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.en: The caravan leader Harkhuf, serving Merenre and Pepi II, returns from the south with 300 donkeys loaded with incense, ebony and ivory (GHA2_CH9 p.251)
early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.ar: قائد القوافل حرخوف، في خدمة مرنرع وببي الثاني، يعود من الجنوب بثلاثمئة حمار محمّلة بالبخور والأبنوس والعاج (GHA2_CH9 p.251) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'He returned from this journey 'with 300 donkeys loaded with incense, ebony, oil, panther skins, elephant tusks'

early-dynastic-old-kingdom-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.251 places Harkhuf in the reigns of Merenre and Pepi II (sixth dynasty, -2434 to -2242 on p.250) without a year; plotted at about -2400. VERIFY

middle-kingdom-egypt.en: Fortresses at the Second Cataract (Buhen, Semna)
Thebes ends the rule of Heracleopolis and reunites the Two Lands; Menthuhotep is the dominant king of the eleventh dynasty (GHA2_CH2 p.97)
middle-kingdom-egypt.ar: طيبة تنهي حكم هيراكليوبوليس وتوحّد الأرضين من جديد، ومنتوحتب هو الملك البارز في الأسرة الحادية عشرة (GHA2_CH2 p.97) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Thebes, previously an unknown and unimportant name, put an end to the rule of Heracleopolis and laid claim to the entire state of Egypt'

middle-kingdom-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.97 dates the Middle Kingdom from -2060

middle-kingdom-egypt.en: Under the twelfth dynasty Nubia is effectively occupied as far as Semna, where Senusret III's boundary stele is set up (GHA2_CH9 p.255)
middle-kingdom-egypt.ar: في عهد الأسرة الثانية عشرة تُحتل النوبة فعلياً حتى سمنة، حيث تُقام لوحة الحدود لسنوسرت الثالث (GHA2_CH9 p.255) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'it was under the twelfth dynasty ( - 1991 to - 1786) that Nubia was effectively occupied as far as Semna, where the southern border of the kingdom was firmly established.'

middle-kingdom-egypt.date_note: Plotted at the start of the twelfth dynasty; Senusret III's stele is later within it

middle-kingdom-egypt.en: Senusret I completes the occupation of Nubia; a Buhen stele names Kush, Sai (Sha'at) and Shemyk among conquered lands (GHA2_CH9 p.256)
middle-kingdom-egypt.ar: سنوسرت الأول يُتم احتلال النوبة، ولوحة في بوهين تذكر كوش وصاي (شاعت) وشميك بين البلاد المفتوحة (GHA2_CH9 p.256) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The occupation of Nubia commenced by Amenemhet I was completed by his son and successor Senusret I.'

middle-kingdom-egypt.date_note: Senusret I is dated c. -1970 to -1930 on GHA II p.145 (ch.4); plotted at -1970

middle-kingdom-egypt.en: The Hyksos begin seriously to challenge the authority of the thirteenth dynasty (GHA2_CH2 p.99)
middle-kingdom-egypt.ar: الهكسوس يبدؤون تحدي سلطة الأسرة الثالثة عشرة تحدياً جدياً (GHA2_CH2 p.99) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The Hyksos only began seriously to challenge the political authority of the thirteenth dynasty about the year - 1729.'

middle-kingdom-egypt.en: By about 1700 BCE the Hyksos conquer the eastern Delta and make Avaris their capital (GHA2_CH2 p.99)
middle-kingdom-egypt.ar: بحلول نحو 1700 ق.م. يستولي الهكسوس على شرق الدلتا ويتخذون أواريس عاصمة لهم (GHA2_CH2 p.99) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'By - 1700, however, they had emerged as a well-organized, well-equipped and warlike people, and they conquered the eastern part of the Delta'

new-kingdom-egypt.en: Conquest of the northern Sudan under Tuthmose I (GHA2_CH9 p.265)
new-kingdom-egypt.ar: غزو شمال السودان في عهد تحتمس الأول (GHA2_CH9 p.265) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'it was Tuthmose I (—1530 to —1520) who accomplished the conquest of the northern Sudan'

new-kingdom-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.268 gives Ramses II the dates '— 1320 to — 1318', the same it gives Ramses I; not used for plotting. VERIFY

new-kingdom-egypt.en: In Thutmose III's reign the annual tribute of Wawat (Lower Nubia) amounts to 550 pounds of gold (GHA2_CH9 p.273)
new-kingdom-egypt.ar: في عهد تحتمس الثالث تبلغ الجزية السنوية لواوات (النوبة السفلى) 550 رطلاً من الذهب (GHA2_CH9 p.273) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'During the reign of King Tuthmose III the annual tribute of Wawat only amounted to 550 pounds.'

new-kingdom-egypt.date_note: Thutmose III is dated -1490 to -1468 on GHA II p.136 (ch.4); plotted at -1490

new-kingdom-egypt.en: The temple of Soleb is built in about 1400 BCE (GHA2_CH4 p.144)
new-kingdom-egypt.ar: بناء معبد صُلب نحو 1400 ق.م. (GHA2_CH4 p.144) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In - 1400, the temple of Soleb was built.'

new-kingdom-egypt.en: The religious revolution of Amenophis IV (Akhenaten) causes upheaval in Egypt but does not disrupt peace in Nubia (GHA2_CH9 p.267)
new-kingdom-egypt.ar: الثورة الدينية لأمنحوتب الرابع (أخناتون) تُحدث اضطراباً في مصر لكنها لا تُخلّ بالسلم في النوبة (GHA2_CH9 p.267) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The political upheaval in Egypt caused by the religious revolution of Amenophis IV ( - 1370 to - 1352) did not disrupt peace in Nubia'

late-period-persian-egypt.en: 26th Dynasty; Psamtik II's expedition takes Napata (GHA II: 591 BCE; often 593 BCE)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: الأسرة السادسة والعشرون؛ حملة بسماتيك الثاني تستولي على نبتة (تاريخ أفريقيا العام، المجلد الثاني: 591 ق.م؛ وكثيراً ما تُؤرَّخ بـ593 ق.م)

late-period-persian-egypt.en: Psamtik I, with Gyges of Lydia and Greek mercenaries, throws off Assyrian overlordship and founds the twenty-sixth dynasty (GHA2_CH2 p.106)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: بسماتيك الأول، بمساعدة جيجس الليدي ومرتزقة إغريق، يتحرر من السيادة الآشورية ويؤسس الأسرة السادسة والعشرين (GHA2_CH2 p.106) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'he managed, with the help of Gyges of Lydia and Greek mercenaries, to throw off all vestiges of Assyrian overlordship and start a new dynasty, the twenty-sixth.'

late-period-persian-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.106 gives -658; the era list uses -664 for the start of the dynasty (CONTESTED)

late-period-persian-egypt.en: Under Necho II (610–595 BCE) Phoenicians are reported by Herodotus to have sailed around Africa; historians disagree on the account (GHA2_CH4 p.148)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: في عهد نخاو الثاني (610–595 ق.م.) يروي هيرودوت أن فينيقيين أبحروا حول أفريقيا، والمؤرخون مختلفون في صحة الرواية (GHA2_CH4 p.148) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'A naval exploration of the African coasts at the time of Pharaoh Necho II, - 610 to - 595, has attracted the attention of research workers, but not all agree on the historical accuracy of the facts reported a century later by Herodotus.'

late-period-persian-egypt.en: About 500 BCE Hecataeus of Miletus, the first Greek geographer to visit Egypt, writes the first systematic description of the world (GHA2_CH6 p.197)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: نحو 500 ق.م. يكتب هيكاتيوس الملطي، أول جغرافي إغريقي يزور مصر، أول وصف منهجي للعالم (GHA2_CH6 p.197) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In about - 500, Hecataeus of Miletus, the first Greek geographer to visit Egypt, wrote the first systematic description of the world.'

late-period-persian-egypt.en: Herodotus of Halicarnassus visits Egypt in about 450 BCE (GHA2_CH6 p.197)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: هيرودوت الهاليكارناسي يزور مصر نحو 450 ق.م. (GHA2_CH6 p.197) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Herodotus of Halicarnassus had visited Egypt in about - 450.'

late-period-persian-egypt.en: The second Persian domination of Egypt begins under Artaxerxes III (GHA2_CH2 p.107)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: السيطرة الفارسية الثانية على مصر تبدأ في عهد أرتحشستا الثالث (GHA2_CH2 p.107) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The second Persian domination of Egypt began under Artaxerxes III in - 341.'

late-period-persian-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.107 gives -341 (often given as 343 BCE elsewhere)

late-period-persian-egypt.en: Alexander the Great invades Egypt after defeating Persia at Issus, ending the second Persian domination (GHA2_CH2 p.107)
late-period-persian-egypt.ar: الإسكندر الأكبر يغزو مصر بعد هزيمة الفرس في إسوس، فتنتهي السيطرة الفارسية الثانية (GHA2_CH2 p.107) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'This was soon brought to an end by Alexander the Great, who invaded Egypt in - 332 after defeating Persia at the battle of Issus.'

ptolemaic-egypt.en: Alexandria, laid out under Alexander, is completed in the reign of Ptolemy II Philadelphus (285–246 BCE) (GHA2_CH6 p.190)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: الإسكندرية، التي خُطّطت في عهد الإسكندر، تكتمل في عهد بطليموس الثاني فيلادلفوس (285–246 ق.م.) (GHA2_CH6 p.190) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the city does not seem to have been completed until the reign of Ptolemy II (- 285 to - 246).'

ptolemaic-egypt.en: The Pharos lighthouse of Alexandria is designed by Sostratus of Cnidus in about 280 BCE (GHA2_CH6 p.191)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: تصميم منارة الإسكندرية (فاروس) على يد سوستراتوس الكنيدي نحو 280 ق.م. (GHA2_CH6 p.191) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'It was designed by Sostratus of Cnidus in about - 280 in the reign of Ptolemy Philadelphus.'

ptolemaic-egypt.en: Ptolemy II becomes the first of his line to sign a treaty of friendship with Rome and send an embassy there (GHA2_CH7 p.208)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: بطليموس الثاني أول ملوك أسرته يعقد معاهدة صداقة مع روما ويرسل إليها سفارة (GHA2_CH7 p.208) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'He was the first of the line to sign a treaty of friendship with Rome and send an embassy there, in - 273.'

ptolemaic-egypt.en: About 245 BCE Ptolemy offers Eratosthenes of Cyrene the post of librarian at Alexandria (GHA2_CH6 p.193)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: نحو 245 ق.م. يعرض بطليموس على إراتوستينس القوريني منصب أمين مكتبة الإسكندرية (GHA2_CH6 p.193) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In about - 245, Ptolemy offered him the post of librarian, which he held until his death.'

ptolemaic-egypt.en: After the battle of Raphia, where Egypt's national troops are beaten, the Greeks' privileged position declines (GHA2_CH7 p.211)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: بعد معركة رفح التي هُزمت فيها القوات الوطنية المصرية يتراجع وضع الإغريق المميز (GHA2_CH7 p.211) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'which had declined considerably after the battle of Raphia in - 217, when Egypt's national troops had been soundly beaten'

ptolemaic-egypt.date_note: CONTESTED: Ptolemaic sources usually record Raphia (217 BCE) as a Ptolemaic victory; GHA II p.211 says Egypt's national troops were 'soundly beaten'. VERIFY

ptolemaic-egypt.en: Rome saves Egypt's independence when Antiochus III invades it (GHA2_CH7 p.208)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: روما تحفظ استقلال مصر حين يغزوها أنطيوخوس الثالث (GHA2_CH7 p.208) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Rome had reciprocated by saving Egypt's independence when Antiochus III invaded it in - 168.'

ptolemaic-egypt.date_note: CONTESTED: GHA II p.208 names Antiochus III; the 168 BCE invasion is generally attributed to Antiochus IV. VERIFY

ptolemaic-egypt.en: Ptolemy Apion bequeaths Cyrenaica to the Roman people, ending Ptolemaic rule there (322–96 BCE) (GHA2_CH6 p.201)
ptolemaic-egypt.ar: بطليموس أبيون يوصي ببرقة للشعب الروماني، فينتهي الحكم البطلمي فيها (322–96 ق.م.) (GHA2_CH6 p.201) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the domination of Cyrenaica by the Ptolemies lasted from - 322 to - 96, when Ptolemy Apion (son of Ptolemy Euergetes II), who was ruling over Cyrenaica, bequeathed it to the Roman people'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Petronius' punitive campaign captures Napata 23 BCE after Meroitic sack of Aswan (GHA II)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: حملة بترونيوس التأديبية تستولي على نبتة 23 ق.م بعد نهب المرويين لأسوان (تاريخ أفريقيا العام، المجلد الثاني)
roman-byzantine-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.290: Petronius 'captured Napata in —23'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Treaty of Samos 21/20 BCE; frontier at Hiera Sycaminos (Maharraqa)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: معاهدة ساموس 21/20 ق.م؛ الحدود عند هيرا سيكامينوس (المحرقة)
roman-byzantine-egypt.date_note: GHA II p.290: 'In —21 or —20 a peace treaty was negotiated at Samos'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Emperor Hadrian makes a long journey in Egypt in 130–131 and founds a town in Middle Egypt (GHA2_CH7 p.212)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: الإمبراطور هادريان يقوم برحلة طويلة في مصر في 130–131 ويؤسس مدينة في مصر الوسطى (GHA2_CH7 p.212) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Hadrian (117-38), showed still greater interest in the country, and in 130 and 131 made a fairly long journey there with his wife.'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Avidius Cassius has himself proclaimed emperor by his troops at Alexandria (GHA2_CH7 p.213)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: أفيديوس كاسيوس يُنادى به إمبراطوراً من جنوده في الإسكندرية (GHA2_CH7 p.213) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in 175, when rumours went about that the emperor was dead, had himself proclaimed emperor by his troops in Alexandria.'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Caracalla grants the Antoninian constitution (GHA2_CH7 p.213)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: كاراكلا يصدر الدستور الأنطوني (GHA2_CH7 p.213) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the emperor's best-known action which was the grant of the Antoninian constitution in 212.'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: The prefect of Egypt Marcus Julius Aemilianus has himself proclaimed emperor and is defeated by Gallienus (GHA2_CH7 p.214)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: والي مصر ماركوس يوليوس إميليانوس يُعلن نفسه إمبراطوراً ويهزمه غالينوس (GHA2_CH7 p.214) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'A prefect of Egypt, Marcus Julius Aemilianus, had himself proclaimed emperor in 262 and was heavily defeated by Gallienus'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Diocletian's persecution of Christians begins the Coptic 'era of the martyrs' (GHA2_CH7 p.217)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: اضطهاد دقلديانوس للمسيحيين يبدأ «عصر الشهداء» القبطي (GHA2_CH7 p.217) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the persecution which eclipsed all others in the popular memory and started the Coptic or the martyrs' era was that which Diocletian (303) unleashed'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: The Council of Chalcedon condemns the doctrine later known as Monophysitism, opening a crisis in Alexandria that lasts until the Muslim conquest (GHA2_CH7 pp.219–220)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: مجمع خلقيدونية يدين المذهب الذي عُرف لاحقاً بالطبيعة الواحدة، فتبدأ أزمة في الإسكندرية تستمر حتى الفتح الإسلامي (GHA2_CH7 pp.219–220) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The Council of Chalcedon condemned this doctrine in 451.'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: The Sassanid Persians reach the Nile Delta (GHA2_CH7 p.222)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: الفرس الساسانيون يبلغون دلتا النيل (GHA2_CH7 p.222) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'towards Aqaba and Egypt, reaching the Nile Delta in 615.'

roman-byzantine-egypt.en: Heraclius reconquers Egypt for Byzantium, giving only a brief respite (GHA2_CH7 p.222)
roman-byzantine-egypt.ar: هرقل يستعيد مصر لبيزنطة، فلا ينال إلا مهلة قصيرة (GHA2_CH7 p.222) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The reconquest of Egypt by Heraclius in 629 gave the Byzantines only a brief respite'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: Alexandria, a fortified city of some 600,000 people and Byzantium's naval centre, capitulates; the Arabs occupy it in September 642 (GHA3_CH7 p.165)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: الإسكندرية، المدينة المحصنة ذات الستمئة ألف نسمة ومركز القوة البحرية البيزنطية، تستسلم ويحتلها العرب في سبتمبر 642 (GHA3_CH7 p.165) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'finally capitulated and the Arabs occupied it in Shawwal 21/September 642.'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: Governor 'Abd Allah launches an expedition against Nubia that reaches Dongola, above the Third Cataract (GHA3_CH7 p.166)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: الوالي عبد الله يشن حملة على النوبة تبلغ دنقلا أعلى الشلال الثالث (GHA3_CH7 p.166) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In 31/652 ' Abd Allah launched an expedition against Nubia, in presentday Sudan, and got as far as Dongola, upstream from the Third Cataract.'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: As taxes on the Egyptian countryside grow more burdensome, the first Coptic revolt breaks out (GHA3_CH7 p.170)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: مع تزايد ثقل الضرائب على الريف المصري تندلع أول ثورة قبطية (GHA3_CH7 p.170) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in 107/725 the first Copt revolt broke out.'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: The Umayyads are overthrown and their last caliph is killed in Egypt in August 750 (GHA3_CH7 p.170)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: الإطاحة بالأمويين ومقتل آخر خلفائهم في مصر في أغسطس 750 (GHA3_CH7 p.170) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In 132/750 the Umayyads were overthrown and their last Caliph was killed in Egypt in August.'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: Ahmad ibn Tulun arrives in Egypt with political and military authority over the province (GHA3_CH7 p.172)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: أحمد بن طولون يصل إلى مصر حاملاً السلطة السياسية والعسكرية على الولاية (GHA3_CH7 p.172) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'who arrived in Egypt in 254/868'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: The caliphate acknowledges Tulunid sovereignty over Egypt and Syria for thirty years (GHA3_CH7 p.174)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: الخلافة تعترف بسيادة الطولونيين على مصر والشام لمدة ثلاثين عاماً (GHA3_CH7 p.174) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in 273/886 the Caliphate acknowledged the sovereignty of the Tulunid dynasty over Egypt and Syria for a period of thirty years.'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: Muhammad ibn Tughdj (later al-Ikhshid) becomes governor of Egypt, founding the Ikhshidid regime (GHA3_CH7 p.178)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: محمد بن طغج (الإخشيد لاحقاً) يتولى ولاية مصر مؤسساً الحكم الإخشيدي (GHA3_CH7 p.178) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In the year of his appointment to Egypt, 323/ 935, he was forced to confront the Berbers'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: The Ayyubid regime established in Cairo takes over from the Fatimid caliphate (GHA4_CH15 p.371)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: النظام الأيوبي الذي قام في القاهرة يخلف الخلافة الفاطمية (GHA4_CH15 p.371) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The regime established in Cairo in +1171 took over the reins from the Fatimid caliphate'

islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.en: Salah al-Din's victory at Hattin and reconquest of Jerusalem (GHA4_CH15 p.373)
islamic-egypt-rashidunfatimidayyubid.ar: انتصار صلاح الدين في حطين واستعادته القدس (GHA4_CH15 p.373) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in 1186 the last territories of the Euphrates basin, which had hitherto held out, were added to the realm; and in the following year the victory of Hattin and the reconquest of Jerusalem'

mamluk-sultanate.en: Mamluk punitive campaigns against the Beduin ('urban) of the south are recorded in 1302, 1351, 1353, 1378 and 1395 (GHA4_CH16 p.402)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: حملات مملوكية تأديبية على «العربان» في الجنوب مسجلة في الأعوام 1302 و1351 و1353 و1378 و1395 (GHA4_CH16 p.402) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The major punitive campaigns of the Mamluk troops against the refractory 'urban - or Beduin, as it became customary to label them - are recorded as taking place in 1302, 1351, 1353, 1378 and 1395.'

mamluk-sultanate.en: In 1305 another Mamluk expedition is sent from Cairo at King Ammy's request for help with internal troubles (GHA4_CH16 p.403)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: عام 1305 تُرسَل حملة مملوكية أخرى من القاهرة بطلب من الملك عمّي للمساعدة في اضطرابات داخلية (GHA4_CH16 p.403) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In 1305 another expedition was sent from Cairo on the request of King Ammy , looking for help with internal troubles.'

mamluk-sultanate.en: A Mamluk expedition of 1323–4 restores King Karanbas, who had embraced Islam in captivity in Cairo (GHA4_CH16 p.404)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: حملة مملوكية في 1323–1324 تعيد الملك كرنبس، الذي اعتنق الإسلام أثناء أسره في القاهرة، إلى العرش (GHA4_CH16 p.404) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'another expedition, in 1323-4, restored to the throne King Karanbas, who had embraced Islam during his temporary captivity in Cairo.'

mamluk-sultanate.en: In 1391 Sultan Barquq receives a letter from the king of Bornu complaining that Arabs are seizing and selling his people (GHA4_CH16 p.422)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: عام 1391 يتلقى السلطان برقوق رسالة من ملك برنو يشكو فيها من أن العرب يأسرون رعاياه ويبيعونهم (GHA4_CH16 p.422) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In 1391 Sultan Barkuk in Cairo received a letter from the king of Bornu complaining of the misbehaviour of the Djudham and other Arabs'

mamluk-sultanate.en: The Ayyubid sultan Turan Shah is assassinated in May 1250 after the Sixth Crusade lands at Damietta (GHA4_CH15 p.379)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: اغتيال السلطان الأيوبي توران شاه في مايو 1250 بعد نزول الحملة الصليبية السادسة في دمياط (GHA4_CH15 p.379) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Turan Shah was assassinated in May 1250.'

mamluk-sultanate.en: Baybars becomes Mamluk sultan (1260–77) after the defeat of the Mongols at 'Ayn Jalut (GHA4_CH15 p.381)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: بيبرس يصبح سلطاناً مملوكياً (1260–1277) بعد هزيمة المغول في عين جالوت (GHA4_CH15 p.381) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the policy of the new sultan, al-Malik al-Zahir Baybars (1260-77).'

mamluk-sultanate.date_note: GHA IV p.380 prints 'September 1290' for 'Ayn Jalut, a misprint for 1260 (Baybars' accession in 1260 on p.381). VERIFY

mamluk-sultanate.en: The northern part of the Christian kingdom of Nubia is annexed and vassal princes are installed at Dongola (GHA4_CH15 p.382)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: ضم الجزء الشمالي من مملكة النوبة المسيحية وتنصيب أمراء تابعين في دنقلا (GHA4_CH15 p.382) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the northern part of the Christian kingdom of Nubia was annexed in 1275, and vassal princes were installed at Dongola'

mamluk-sultanate.date_note: GHA III p.168 (ch.7) gives 1276 for Baybars' subjection of Nubia (CONTESTED by one year)

mamluk-sultanate.en: The Mamluks capture Acre, the last Christian stronghold on the coast of Palestine (GHA4_CH15 p.381)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: المماليك يستولون على عكا، آخر معقل مسيحي على ساحل فلسطين (GHA4_CH15 p.381) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the capture of St John of Acre in 1291 - the last Christian stronghold on the coast of Palestine'

mamluk-sultanate.en: The Dongola church is turned into a mosque; its inscription gives the date 29 May 1317 (GHA4_CH15 p.382)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: تحويل كنيسة دنقلا إلى مسجد، ونقشه يحمل تاريخ 29 مايو 1317 (GHA4_CH15 p.382) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'which was transformed into a mosque, has an inscription giving the exact date: 29 May 1317'

mamluk-sultanate.en: Mansa Musa of Mali distributes gold in Cairo during his pilgrimage (GHA4_CH15 p.382)
mamluk-sultanate.ar: منسا موسى ملك مالي يوزع الذهب في القاهرة أثناء حجه (GHA4_CH15 p.382) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the gold distributed by Mansa Musa during his pilgrimage of 1324.'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: The Ottomans conquer Egypt in 1517 and view the Funj extension into Lower Nubia with suspicion (GHA5_CH7 p.174)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: العثمانيون يفتحون مصر عام 1517 وينظرون بريبة إلى امتداد سلطة الفونج نحو النوبة السفلى (GHA5_CH7 p.174) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'seems to have been viewed with suspicion by the Ottomans, who conquered Egypt in 1517.'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: Özdemir Pasha takes the frontier fortresses of Ibrim and Dirr; the new province of Berberistan is garrisoned by Bosnian soldiers at Aswan, Ibrim and Say (GHA5_CH7 p.175)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: أوزدمير باشا يستولي على قلعتي إبريم والدر الحدوديتين، وتُرابط حامية بوسنية في أسوان وإبريم وصاي في ولاية بربرستان الجديدة (GHA5_CH7 p.175) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'appears to have been established when a garrison of Bosnian soldiers was installed at the fortresses of Aswan, Ibrim and Say.'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.date_note: GHA V p.175 dates Özdemir's retirement from the governorship of Yemen to November 1554; the Nubian campaign follows; plotted at 1555. VERIFY

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: The Egyptian frontier is finally consolidated at Hannik after fighting between the 'Abdallabi and the Ottomans in about 1622 (GHA5_CH7 p.175)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: الحدود المصرية تستقر نهائياً عند حنّك بعد قتال بين العبدلاب والعثمانيين نحو 1622 (GHA5_CH7 p.175) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The Egyptian frontier was finally consolidated at Hannik after some fighting between the 'Abdallabi and the Ottomans in about 1622.'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: In 1811 Mamluks fleeing Muhammad 'Ali's massacre set up a camp at New Dongola and fight the Shaykiyya (GHA5_CH7 p.185)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: عام 1811 يفر المماليك من مذبحة محمد علي ويقيمون معسكراً في دنقلا العرضي ويقاتلون الشايقية (GHA5_CH7 p.185) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The Shaykiyya warriors who became a major force in the region of Dunkula were harassed by the Mamluks of Egypt. In 1811, they fled from Muhammad 'Ali's massacre, established a camp at Dunkula al-'Urdi and fought the Shaykiyya.'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: Muhammad 'Ali assumes power in Egypt in 1805, then one of the poorest Ottoman provinces (GHA6_CH14 p.361)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: محمد علي يتولى السلطة في مصر عام 1805، وكانت حينئذ من أفقر ولايات الدولة العثمانية (GHA6_CH14 p.361) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'On his assumption of power in 1805, Egypt was one of the poorest provinces of the Ottoman empire'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: Egyptian officers under Colonel Ahmad 'Urabi launch a revolution in February 1881 against European control and Khedive Tawfiq (GHA7_CH4 p.65)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: الضباط المصريون بقيادة العقيد أحمد عرابي يطلقون ثورة في فبراير 1881 ضد السيطرة الأوروبية والخديوي توفيق (GHA7_CH4 p.65) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'launched a revolution early in February 1881 against European colonialism and Khedive Tawfik.'

ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.en: The British fleet bombards Alexandria on 11 July 1882 (GHA7_CH4 p.67)
ottoman-egypt-muhammad-ali-dynasty.ar: الأسطول البريطاني يقصف الإسكندرية في 11 يوليو 1882 (GHA7_CH4 p.67) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'This gave the British fleet a further pretext to bombard Alexandria on 11 July 1882.'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: Co-domini of Sudan under the Anglo-Egyptian agreement of January 1899 (LOC1991_CONDO)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: شريكا الحكم في السودان بموجب الاتفاقية الإنجليزية المصرية في يناير 1899 (LOC1991_CONDO) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In January 1899, an Anglo-Egyptian agreement restored Egyptian rule in Sudan but as part of a condominium'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: Wolseley's army breaks the 'Urabist revolution at al-Tall al-Kabir on 13 September 1882 and occupies Egypt (GHA7_CH4 p.67)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: جيش ولسلي يكسر الثورة العرابية في التل الكبير في 13 سبتمبر 1882 ويحتل مصر (GHA7_CH4 p.67) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'broke the backbone of the revolution in the battle of al-Tall al-Kabir on 13 September 1882, 7 and occupied the country.'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: Khedive 'Abbas II forces the pro-British prime minister to resign on 15 January 1893, challenging Cromer (GHA7_CH4 p.70)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: الخديوي عباس الثاني يجبر رئيس الوزراء الموالي لبريطانيا على الاستقالة في 15 يناير 1893 متحدياً كرومر (GHA7_CH4 p.70) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'succeeded in forcing the pro-British prime minister to resign on 15 January 1893.'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: The Fashoda incident of 1898 shows that France will not go to war with England over Egypt (GHA7_CH4 p.70)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: حادثة فاشودة عام 1898 تُظهر أن فرنسا لن تخوض حرباً مع إنجلترا من أجل مصر (GHA7_CH4 p.70) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Nor was she ready to go to war with England over Egypt, as the Fashoda incident had shown in 1898.'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: The Dinshaway incident of May 1906 boosts Mustafa Kamil's campaign and Egyptian nationalism (GHA7_CH4 p.72)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: حادثة دنشواي في مايو 1906 تعزز حملة مصطفى كامل والحركة الوطنية المصرية (GHA7_CH4 p.72) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'His political activities began to bear fruit as he was able to organize a strike of law students in February 1906. The Dinshaway incident of May 1906 profoundly boosted Kamil's campaign in Egypt.'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: Cromer retires in 1907; Mustafa Kamil's Nationalist Party is inaugurated publicly the same year (GHA7_CH4 p.72)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: كرومر يتقاعد عام 1907، ويُعلن الحزب الوطني بزعامة مصطفى كامل في العام نفسه (GHA7_CH4 p.72) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Cromer retired in 1907 to make way for a new Consul-General, Eldon Gorst'

british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.en: Egyptian nationalists come out in open revolt against the British occupation in 1919 (GHA7_CH4 p.73)
british-occupied-kingdom-of-egypt.ar: الوطنيون المصريون يعلنون الثورة المفتوحة على الاحتلال البريطاني عام 1919 (GHA7_CH4 p.73) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The nationalists had to wait until 1919 before coming out in open revolt against the British occupation.'

republic-of-egypt.en: Nasser announces nationalization of the Suez Canal Company, 26 July 1956, to finance the Aswan High Dam
republic-of-egypt.ar: عبد الناصر يعلن تأميم شركة قناة السويس في 26 يوليو 1956 لتمويل السد العالي بأسوان [يحتاج تحقق]

republic-of-egypt.en: Israel, Britain and France invade Egypt, October–November 1956; hostilities cease 6 November under US and Soviet pressure
republic-of-egypt.ar: إسرائيل وبريطانيا وفرنسا تغزو مصر في أكتوبر–نوفمبر 1956؛ وتتوقف الأعمال العدائية في 6 نوفمبر تحت ضغط أمريكي وسوفيتي [يحتاج تحقق]

land-of-punt-d-mt.en: South Arabian period in northern Ethiopia: monuments and inscriptions in Eritrea and Tigre akin to those of Saba, dated 5th–4th centuries BC; temple of Yeha
land-of-punt-d-mt.ar: الحقبة العربية الجنوبية في شمال إثيوبيا: آثار ونقوش في إريتريا وتيغراي شبيهة بآثار سبأ، مؤرخة بالقرنين الخامس والرابع ق.م؛ معبد يحا [يحتاج تحقق]

kingdom-of-aksum.ar: المسيحية في عهد عيزانا نحو ثلاثينيات القرن الرابع [يحتاج تحقق]

kingdom-of-aksum.date_note: Year 350 not printed on any registered page (GHA II p.293); date removed.

zagwe-dynasty.en: King Lalibela (c. 1181–c. 1221) founds a new capital he calls 'New Jerusalem'
zagwe-dynasty.ar: الملك لاليبلا (نحو 1181–نحو 1221) يؤسس عاصمة جديدة يسميها «القدس الجديدة» [يحتاج تحقق]

zagwe-dynasty.en: Christian kingdom of the Ethiopian highlands passes from the Zagwe to the Solomonid dynasty, 1270
zagwe-dynasty.ar: انتقال المملكة المسيحية في المرتفعات الإثيوبية من أسرة زاغوي إلى الأسرة السليمانية، 1270 [يحتاج تحقق]

ethiopian-empire-solomonic.date_note: 1636 printed at GHA V pp.709, 724–725; uncited end year 1769 cut from EN/AR text per Innovation Manager ruling 2026-10-25 (not printed in any registered source).

ethiopian-empire-solomonic.en: Battle of Gallabat (Matamma) vs Mahdists, 10 March 1889; Emperor Yohannes IV mortally wounded
ethiopian-empire-solomonic.ar: معركة القلابات (المتمة) ضد المهدويين، 10 مارس 1889؛ وإصابة الإمبراطور يوحنا الرابع إصابة قاتلة [يحتاج تحقق]

ethiopian-empire-solomonic.en: Funj–Ethiopian frontier clashes escalate in 1618 and 1619, with large numbers of troops and a few muskets (GHA5_CH7 p.178)
ethiopian-empire-solomonic.ar: تصاعد الاشتباكات الحدودية بين الفونج والحبشة في 1618 و1619 بأعداد كبيرة من الجنود وعدد محدود من البنادق (GHA5_CH7 p.178) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Frontier clashes escalated during 1618 and 1619, when large numbers of troops, using a limited number of muskets, were involved.'

ethiopian-empire-solomonic.en: In March 1744 Iyasu II marches at the head of a large Ethiopian army against Sennar (GHA5_CH7 p.178)
ethiopian-empire-solomonic.ar: في مارس 1744 يزحف إياسو الثاني على رأس جيش حبشي كبير نحو سنار (GHA5_CH7 p.178) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In March 1744, Iyasu II marched at the head of a large Ethiopian army against Sennar.'

derg-federal-ethiopia.en: After the emperor is overthrown, Colonel Mengistu's Derg adopts the socialist model, backed by the socialist world
derg-federal-ethiopia.ar: بعد الإطاحة بالإمبراطور، يتبنى الديرغ بقيادة العقيد منغستو النموذج الاشتراكي بدعم من العالم الاشتراكي [يحتاج تحقق]
منغستو هايلي مريام يفر من إثيوبيا، 1991 [يحتاج تحقق]

kanem-empire.ar: اعتناق الإسلام في القرن الحادي عشر [يحتاج تحقق]

bornu-empire.ar: إدريس ألوما في القرن السادس عشر

wadai-sultanate.en: 'Abd al-Karim b. Jame (r.1611–55), who had studied in Borno, founds Wadai, probably with Borno's blessing (GHA5_BORNU_P493_513 p.511)
wadai-sultanate.ar: عبد الكريم بن جامع (حكم 1611–1655)، الذي تعلّم في برنو، يؤسس وداي، على الأرجح بمباركة برنو (GHA5_BORNU_P493_513 p.511) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: ''Abd al-Karîm b. Jame (r.1611-55), who studied in Borno, founded Wadai - no doubt with Borno's blessing'

wadai-sultanate.date_note: Abd al-Karim's reign is dated r.1611–55 on GHA V p.511; plotted at the start of the reign. The era record starts at 1635 (CONTESTED).

wadai-sultanate.en: Mid-18th century: Sultan Muhammad Djawda of Wadai defeats an invading Fur army and captures the Fur sultan 'Umar Lei (GHA5_CH7 p.188)
wadai-sultanate.ar: منتصف القرن الثامن عشر: سلطان وداي محمد جودة يهزم جيش الفور الغازي ويأسر سلطان الفور عمر ليل (GHA5_CH7 p.188) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'After heavy fighting, the Sultan of Wadai, Muhammad Djawda, defeated the Für army and captured the sultan.'

wadai-sultanate.en: Darfur's Sultan Tayrab, failing to expand west, concludes a treaty with Wadai that holds for a hundred years (GHA5_CH7 p.189)
wadai-sultanate.ar: سلطان دارفور تيراب، بعد إخفاقه في التوسع غرباً، يعقد مع وداي معاهدة تدوم مئة عام (GHA5_CH7 p.189) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Having failed to expand westward against his formidable foe, the Sultan of Wadai, Tayrâb, concluded a treaty which remained effective for a hundred years.'

wadai-sultanate.date_note: No year for the Tayrab–Wadai treaty is printed on GHA V p.189 or found in the other sources read; left undated. VERIFY

wadai-sultanate.en: Wadai under Jawda (r.1747–95) pursues expansion towards the Bahr al-Ghazal (GHA5_BORNU_P493_513 p.513)
wadai-sultanate.ar: وداي في عهد جودة (حكم 1747–1795) تواصل التوسع نحو بحر الغزال (GHA5_BORNU_P493_513 p.513) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Wadai under Jawda (r. 1747-95) continued its expansionist policies towards Bahr al-Ghazäl.'

wadai-sultanate.date_note: Plotted at the start of Jawda's reign (r.1747–95, GHA V p.513); the expansion is not dated to a single year.

wadai-sultanate.en: 19th century: Wadai sultans, grown powerful since the mid-18th century, promote the direct Benghazi–Wadai route bypassing Borno and Darfur (GHA6_SAHARA_P530 p.530)
wadai-sultanate.ar: القرن التاسع عشر: سلاطين وداي، وقد قويت دولتهم منذ منتصف القرن الثامن عشر، يشجعون الطريق المباشر بين بنغازي ووداي متجاوزين برنو ودارفور (GHA6_SAHARA_P530 p.530) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Wadai sultans, whose state had grown increasingly powerful after the mid-eighteenth century, were anxious to promote a route which bypassed Borno to the west and Dârfur to the east.'

wadai-sultanate.date_note: GHA VI p.475 (ch.17): 'a new direct link between Wadaï and Barka, discovered in 1809 or 1810, became a major caravan route after 1850.' Plotted at 1809.

garamantes-fezzan.en: Proconsul Cornelius Balbus raids the kingdom of the Garamantes of the Fezzan, 19 BC
garamantes-fezzan.ar: البروقنصل كورنيليوس بالبوس يغير على مملكة الجرمنت في فزان، 19 ق.م [يحتاج تحقق]

garamantes-fezzan.removed: No year found: GHA II p.522 says only that from Garama the Garamantes 'soon wielded supremacy over the whole of the Fezzan' and that they were 'mentioned by Herodotus as early as the fifth century before our era'; neither dates the supremacy/tribute. Line deleted (IM QA: undated event dropped at build).

libya-ottoman-italian-independent.removed: r25 triage: No registered source covers Libyan independence 1951 (GHA VIII text unavailable).

libya-ottoman-italian-independent.en: The Sanusiyya brotherhood, founded in Barka (Cyrenaica) in 1843, organises a major caravan route from Barka to Wadai (GHA6_CH17 p.473)
libya-ottoman-italian-independent.ar: الطريقة السنوسية، التي تأسست في برقة عام 1843، تنظّم طريق قوافل كبيراً من برقة إلى وداي (GHA6_CH17 p.473) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the Sanüsiyya, a religious brotherhood ... had been founded in 1843. It rapidly carved out a prominent place for itself through its success in organizing a major caravan route from Barka to Wadai'

libya-ottoman-italian-independent.en: After the Awlad Sulayman's defeat (1842) and the Mahamid's submission (1858), the Ottomans rule all of Tripolitania and part of the Fezzan (GHA6_CH17 p.473)
libya-ottoman-italian-independent.ar: بعد هزيمة أولاد سليمان (1842) وخضوع المحاميد (1858) يحكم العثمانيون طرابلس الغرب كلها وجزءاً من فزان (GHA6_CH17 p.473) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'The Ottomans now ruled over the whole of Tripolitania and part of the Fezzän.'

libya-ottoman-italian-independent.en: King Idris proclaims the independence of the United Kingdom of Libya, 24 December 1951 (UNYB1951_LIBYA p.266)
libya-ottoman-italian-independent.ar: الملك إدريس السنوسي يعلن استقلال المملكة الليبية المتحدة، 24 ديسمبر 1951 (UNYB1951_LIBYA p.266) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'On 24 December 1951, King Mohamad Idris Al Mahdi Al Senussi proclaimed the independence of the United Kingdom of Libya'

central-african-republic-ubangi-shari.removed: no source page found: no UN/aid agency page read states CAR independence in 1960

central-african-republic-ubangi-shari.en: Oubangui diamonds discovered in 1913; their exploitation begins only in the 1930s (GHA7_CH15 p.376)
central-african-republic-ubangi-shari.ar: اكتشاف ماس أوبانغي عام 1913؛ ولم يبدأ استغلاله إلا في ثلاثينيات القرن العشرين (GHA7_CH15 p.376) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'the exploitation of Oubangui diamonds, discovered in 1913, was not begun until the 1930s.'

central-african-republic-ubangi-shari.en: Early 1920s: cotton in Oubangui-Chari among the first large-scale speculative enterprises of French Equatorial Africa (GHA7_CH15 p.370)
central-african-republic-ubangi-shari.ar: مطلع العشرينيات: القطن في أوبانغي شاري من أولى المشروعات المضاربية الكبرى في أفريقيا الاستوائية الفرنسية (GHA7_CH15 p.370) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'served to launch the first large-scale speculative enterprise - cotton in Oubangui-Chari (now Central African Republic), timber in Gabon and Ivory Coast — in the early 1920s'

sabaean-south-arabian-kingdoms.en: Mârib, capital of the kingdom of Saba: its principal temple on a tiered base parallels the temple of Yeha in Ethiopia
sabaean-south-arabian-kingdoms.ar: مأرب عاصمة مملكة سبأ: معبدها الرئيسي القائم على قاعدة مدرّجة يناظر معبد يحا في إثيوبيا [يحتاج تحقق]

rise-of-islam-caliphates.date_note: GHA III ch.19 p.560 prints "In about 615"; emigration also at GHA III ch.2 p.35.

rise-of-islam-caliphates.ar: التجارة العباسية عبر البحر الأحمر [يحتاج تحقق]

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.en: Ottoman Habesh province port from 16th c.
suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.ar: ميناء ولاية الحبش العثمانية منذ القرن السادس عشر

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.en: In 1264–5 Sultan Baybars punishes the Arab ruler of Sawakin by military action, then appoints him a Mamluk representative (GHA4_CH16 p.418)
suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.ar: في 1264–1265 يعاقب السلطان بيبرس حاكم سواكن العربي عسكرياً ثم يعيّنه ممثلاً للمماليك (GHA4_CH16 p.418) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In 1264-5 Sultan Baybars punished the Arab ruler of Sawakin by military action, but later consented to appoint him as a Mamluk representative.'

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.en: In the mid-15th century a Mamluk army captures Sawakin again and makes it subject to more direct authority (GHA4_CH16 p.418)
suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.ar: في منتصف القرن الخامس عشر يستولي جيش مملوكي على سواكن مجدداً ويخضعها لسلطته المباشرة (GHA4_CH16 p.418) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In the middle of the fifteenth century Sawakin was captured again by a Mamluk army and made subject to their more direct authority.'

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.date_note: Century only in GHA IV p.418; plotted at 1450

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.en: Under Özdemir Pasha, Sawakin, nominally dependent on Mamluk Egypt, passes to Ottoman suzerainty; Massawa is annexed in 1557 (GHA5_CH7 p.175)
suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.ar: في عهد أوزدمير باشا تنتقل سواكن، التابعة اسمياً لمصر المملوكية، إلى السيادة العثمانية، وتُضم مصوع عام 1557 (GHA5_CH7 p.175) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'Sawakin, which was nominally dependent on Mamluk Egypt, passed to Ottoman suzerainty, and Massawa was annexed in 1557.'

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.date_note: GHA V p.175 dates Massawa's annexation to 1557; the passage of Sawakin is not separately dated

suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.en: In 1571, according to Ottoman sources, the Funj (or perhaps the Beja) attack Sawakin and besiege it for three months (GHA5_CH7 p.175)
suakin-red-sea-port-beja-ottoman.ar: عام 1571، بحسب المصادر العثمانية، يهاجم الفونج (أو ربما البجا) سواكن ويحاصرونها ثلاثة أشهر (GHA5_CH7 p.175) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'In 1571, according to Ottoman sources, the Fundj (or perhaps more accurately the Bedja) attacked Sawakin and besieged it for three months.'

beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.en: Blemmyes (GHA II: 'customarily identified with the Bedja tribes') raid Upper Egypt; suppressed under Probus (276–282 CE)
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.ar: البليميون (تاريخ أفريقيا العام، المجلد الثاني: «يُطابَقون عادةً مع قبائل البجة») يغيرون على صعيد مصر؛ قُمعوا في عهد بروبوس (276–282 م)
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.date_note: GHA II p.215: Blemmyes dominated under Probus (276-82); year = start of reign

beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.en: After Meroe's fall the Nobades push the Blemmyes ('Bega or Buga') into the eastern desert
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.ar: بعد سقوط مروي دفع النوباديون البليميين («البجة أو البوجة») إلى الصحراء الشرقية

beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.en: Recognised by medieval Muslim writers as distinct from Nubians, Arabs and 'Sudan'
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.ar: ميّزهم الكتّاب المسلمون في العصور الوسطى عن النوبة والعرب و«السودان»

beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.en: Camel-nomads of the Red Sea Hills; gradual Islamisation and varying arabisation
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.ar: رعاة إبل رحّل في تلال البحر الأحمر؛ أسلمة تدريجية وتعريب متفاوت

beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.en: Nabtab ruling clan of the Banu 'Amir claims Ja'ali descent
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.ar: النابتاب، العشيرة الحاكمة لبني عامر، يدّعون النسب الجعلي

beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.en: 'Ababda (north) Arabic-speaking; 18th c. southward expansion; Hadendowa in Taka (Gash) by early 19th c.
beja-red-sea-hills-peoples.ar: العبابدة (في الشمال) يتحدثون العربية؛ توسع نحو الجنوب في القرن الثامن عشر؛ والهدندوة في التاكا (القاش) بحلول مطلع القرن التاسع عشر [يحتاج تحقق]

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Founded by 'Abdallah Jamma' (Rufa'a) at the Blue/White Nile confluence, late 15th c.
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: أسسها عبد الله جمّاع (من رفاعة) عند ملتقى النيلين الأزرق والأبيض أواخر القرن الخامس عشر [يحتاج تحقق]

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Prospered from tolls on desert nomads
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: ازدهرت من المكوس المفروضة على رحّل البادية

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Recognised by Funj sultans as paramount chiefs of the Arabs
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: اعترف بهم سلاطين الفونج شيوخاً أعلى للعرب [يحتاج تحقق]

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: Capital Qarri, later Halfayat al-Muluk; an 'Abdallabi chief ruled Quz Rajab on the Atbara
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: العاصمة قرّي ثم حلفاية الملوك؛ وحكم شيخ عبدلابي قوز رجب على نهر عطبرة [يحتاج تحقق]

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: At Arbaji in 1504 the Funj defeat the 'Abdallabi, whose king becomes a vassal; they go on ruling the northern part of the sultanate until 1820 (GHA5_CH7 p.173)
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: في أربجي عام 1504 يهزم الفونج العبدلاب ويصبح ملكهم تابعاً، ويستمرون في حكم الجزء الشمالي من السلطنة حتى 1820 (GHA5_CH7 p.173) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in 1504, the Fundj defeated the 'Abdallabi and their king was reduced to the position of vassal.'

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: About the middle of the 17th century the Shaykiyya chieftaincy challenges 'Abdallabi hegemony and asserts its independence from the Funj sultanate (GHA5_CH7 p.174)
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: نحو منتصف القرن السابع عشر تتحدى مشيخة الشايقية هيمنة العبدلاب وتعلن استقلالها عن سلطنة الفونج (GHA5_CH7 p.174) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'in about the middle of the seventeenth century, the Shaykiyya chieftaincy challenged the 'Abdallabi hegemony and asserted its independence from the Fundj sultanate.'

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.date_note: Mid-century only in GHA V p.174; plotted at 1650

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.en: After Abu Likaylik's death in 1776/7 the Funj kings conspire with provincial governors, particularly the 'Abdallab, to oust the Hamaj regents (GHA5_CH7 p.185)
abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.ar: بعد وفاة أبو لكيلك في 1776/1777 يتآمر ملوك الفونج مع حكام الأقاليم، ولا سيما العبدلاب، لإزاحة الأوصياء الهمج (GHA5_CH7 p.185) [يحتاج تحقق]

cite.cite_text: 'On the death of Abu Likaylik in 1776/7, the Fundj kings began to conspire with the provincial governors, particularly the 'Abdallah, to oust their regents.'

abdallab-chiefdom-funj-vassal.date_note: GHA V p.185 prints ''Abdallah' here; in context the 'Abdallab (VERIFY against the printed page)

ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.en: Tribal kingdom between the Atbara confluence and the Sabaluqa Gorge from the 16th c.
ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.ar: مملكة قبلية بين ملتقى عطبرة وخانق السبلوقة منذ القرن السادس عشر

ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.en: Royal clan the Sa'dab; Mirafab kingdom at Berber to the north
ja-aliyyin-kingdom-sa-dab-funj-vassal.ar: العشيرة الملكية السعداب؛ ومملكة الميرفاب في بربر شمالاً [يحتاج تحقق]
